decision.reason: Character.ai official Chapter 11 announcement says current operations continue but may cease if sale fails; users may need to inventory legitimate exports and service migration evidence.

opportunities.idea_name: AI Character Service Exit Readiness Checklist
opportunities.core_job: Help AI character creators inventory/export their own data and permissions and plan continuity if their SaaS platform winds down
opportunities.target_customer: Character.ai creators, community moderators and businesses maintaining externally hosted personas
opportunities.product_mechanism: User-owned exported data index and character asset metadata, deadline reminders, platform policy records, allowable export/rights checklist and destination planning; offline browser-driven, no scraping or platform API
opportunities.why_now: Character.ai official 12 October 2026 notice states Chapter 11 sale process expected by late November or early December; platform may be wound down if no continuity buyer is found, and data export is supported now.
opportunities.before_state: Creators' chats, persona definitions, data ownership references and subscription/export steps are tracked manually with no exit plan
opportunities.after_state: Document owned personas → check permissible export → create evidence manifest → compare allowable destination import needs → follow status/deadline with human controls
opportunities.evidence_note: Company states no shutdown decision is final and platform remains active; never assert an export API or guarantee that entire persona definitions can be exported.
